description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git submodule application and switching strategies, involving functions to apply patches with different options and calling external test libraries.

methods.name: apply_index
methods.description: Applies a Git diff ignoring submodules' dirty state, checks for expected failure, and applies the patch with index option.

methods.name: apply_3way
methods.description: Applies a Git diff ignoring submodules' dirty state, checks for expected failure, and applies the patch with 3way merge option.
